# Synthetic test invoices

These invoices were written for phlox. They cover what the imported EN 16931 examples do not. The
following UBL 2.1 invoices are used by the writer tests (rendered to PDF and HTML):

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `ubl/invoice/phlox-long-invoice.xml` | 120 lines, two VAT rates, long item descriptions: page breaks, the repeated table header, the totals at the end |
| `ubl/invoice/phlox-cyrillic-greek-invoice.xml` | Seller in Bulgaria (Cyrillic), buyer in Greece (Greek), intra-community supply: characters that the standard PDF fonts do not contain |
| `ubl/invoice/phlox-jpy-invoice.xml` | Japanese yen, a currency without decimals, large amounts, two VAT rates |

These three files are generated by `phlox-testfiles/tools/generate-synthetic.py` (decimal
arithmetic, so the totals are consistent); change the script and run it again instead of editing
the files.
phlox does not validate business rules, so the files are not checked against the EN 16931 rules.

All names, addresses, numbers and account numbers are made up.

## Reader edge cases

These files are written by hand and are read by the tests of the readers only. They are valid
against the XSD, but deliberately not valid EN 16931 documents: each one collects the cases where a
reader has to decide something, for example a credit note type code in an `Invoice`, the filler
`None`, a card or a direct debit in the second payment means, blank elements, two payment terms or
values with surrounding spaces.

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `ubl/invoice/phlox-reader-ubl21-invoice.xml` | UBL 2.1 `Invoice` with BT-3 = 381; also read as UBL 2.5 for the elements of the 2017 binding |
| `ubl/creditnote/phlox-reader-ubl21-creditnote.xml` | UBL 2.1 `CreditNote` with BT-3 = 380, BT-18 as `cbc:DocumentType` = `ATS`, BT-9 in `cac:PaymentMeans` |
| `ubl/invoice/phlox-reader-ubl25-invoice.xml` | The same for UBL 2.5, with the filler on all line references |
| `ubl/creditnote/phlox-reader-ubl25-creditnote.xml` | The same for a UBL 2.5 `CreditNote` |
| `cii/phlox-reader-d16b.xml` | CII D16B with BT-3 = 503, BT-8 = 5, dates that cannot be read, BT-90 and BT-91 without BT-89 |
| `cii/phlox-reader-d25a.xml` | The same for CII D25A, with `ram:BuyerReference` of the 2017 binding and BT-184 |

## Repeated elements

These files were generated once and are not regenerated. Each one holds every element twice that
EN 16931 has only once but the syntax allows repeatedly, and every value is unique, so that the
regression test `PdfAllDataShownTest` of `phlox-pdf` can tell them apart. The readers show the first
occurrence in its term and every other one as an additional term. They are valid against the XSD,
but deliberately not valid EN 16931 documents.

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `ubl/invoice/phlox-repeated-ubl21-invoice.xml` | UBL 2.1 `Invoice` |
| `ubl/creditnote/phlox-repeated-ubl21-creditnote.xml` | UBL 2.1 `CreditNote` |
| `ubl/invoice/phlox-repeated-ubl25-invoice.xml` | UBL 2.5 `Invoice` |
| `ubl/creditnote/phlox-repeated-ubl25-creditnote.xml` | UBL 2.5 `CreditNote` |
| `cii/phlox-repeated-d16b.xml` | CII D16B, with unreadable dates, a date with a time and a long token in a table cell |
| `cii/phlox-repeated-d25a.xml` | The same for CII D25A |
